scripts.deploy:development: npm run migrate:development && wrangler deploy --env development
scripts.migrate:development: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env development

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Discord application public key, from the Developer Portal's General Information page. Required to verify interaction requests.

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Discord application ID, from the Developer Portal's General Information page.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal's Bot page. Required for Discord API requests. Keep this secret.
